[GovernanceFilter](./core.governancefilter.md)

</td><td>

_(Optional)_ Active governance filter to apply \*\*before\*\* slicing to `limit`<!-- -->.

When provided, `deny`<!-- -->-d capabilities are dropped from the ranked list before the limit is applied, so lower-ranked allowed capabilities backfill the result set up to `limit`<!-- -->. This ensures "give me the top N" means "N \*usable\* results", not "N results then silently drop some".

The returned array contains only `allow`<!-- -->/`warn` capabilities (up to `limit`<!-- -->). Use [governedDiscoverySearch()](./core.governeddiscoverysearch.md) (in `discovery.ts`<!-- -->) when you also need to distinguish "nothing matched" from "all matches denied".

</td></tr>
